scopes.title: Read
scopes.description: See pods, nodes, templates, volumes and spend — nothing is changed.
can: list and inspect pods (all of the account's, or only its own — see pod visibility)
read pod logs, GPU and hardware metrics
browse nodes and prices, templates, volumes, SSH keys
read the spend statement and the account event log

scopes.title: Rent
scopes.description: Start new pods; the key then controls the pods it started.
can: rent a node, rent by spec, rent a cluster
reboot, edit, add SSH keys to and delete the pods it started
create templates and volumes for them

scopes.title: Manage
scopes.description: Control pods this key did not start, when its pod visibility is the whole account.
can: reboot, edit, switch the template of, and delete pods started by other keys or in the browser
manage the account's templates, volumes, SSH keys and backup schedules

scopes.title: Billing
scopes.description: Move money: card payments, credit transfers, crypto top-ups, auto top-up and wallets. Off unless you pick it.
can: top up by card (Stripe checkout, saved payment methods)
top up with crypto (Coinbase, TAO, TMC Pay) and manage wallets
read and change the auto top-up settings

pod_visibility.description: Only the pods this key creates. Pods from other keys or the browser do not exist for it.
Every pod of the account, within the key's scopes (read sees them, manage controls them).
